hints.content: To translate $\triangle ABC$ by $1$ unit to the left and $5$ units up, we basically translate $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD{A(0,-5)}$ is translated to $\greenD{(-1,0)}$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a triangle with vertices A B C and Vertex A at zero, negative five, vertex B at two, two, and vertex C at seven, zero. The x- and y- axes scale by one. A dashed line moves from vertex A one unit left and five units up to a point at negative one, zero.

hints.content:
Doing this for all vertices and connecting them, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a triangle with vertices A B C and Vertex A at zero, negative five, vertex B at two, two, and vertex C at seven, zero. The x- and y- axes scale by one. A dashed line moves from all three vertices one unit left and five units up to form the image of a triangle with vertices negative one, zero, one, seven, and six, five.

question.content:
